assumes.assumed: Use the handoff working row format, PreviewDeps, terminal receipts, lane/availability rules, positions, accounting and no-run provenance by reference (JI.2, JI.15, JI.32). These are integrator proposals, not accepted contracts.
assumes.if_other: Reconcile row defaults, freshness comparison, terminal mappings and provenance encoding with the final EN4 definitions; do not create parallel shared types or waive A5.

assumes.assumed: Flat ia16-expanded-le/1 literal payload with optional closed named annotations; data-core adoption remains conditional (JI.18-JI.23).
assumes.if_other: A narrower envelope retains the same literal payload and pins; a deferred byte profile leaves this unaccepted. A later referenced-parts carrier must preserve expansion, big-integer length, dependencies and per-prefix semantics and receive a scoped reconciliation.

assumes.assumed: Use the existing ENG-0J I_a identity and separate order digest as current inputs, without a new menu choice (JI.3, JI.47).
assumes.if_other: An owner-selected different menu requires a versioned identity/order, appropriate carrier/input conventions and renewed affected evidence. Existing words cannot be relabelled.

assumes.assumed: Four logical seat bindings, using right cosets and pinned exact representative rotations; physical keys remain G6 work (JI.36).
assumes.if_other: If XM1 causes an owner change to axis-then-angle or palette/drag, replace only the bindings. The resolved menu row, absolute letters and journal identity remain.

assumes.assumed: Live menu twists use an explicit action token and protection without a preview; drafted turns and words use a presented preview (JI.37).
assumes.if_other: If the owner requires a preview for every turn, the menu commit row gains fresh_preview and preview=required and receives one-letter previews.

assumes.assumed: No approved product scramble policy is supplied by this packet, so the row is unavailable (JI.38).
assumes.if_other: An owner-approved depth and retained/jumble mix supplies the policy reference and admission costs, while the separate hidden witness and ordinary preview/execute transaction remain.

assumes.assumed: Journal branches and separately pinned research jobs follow KN4.6/KN7.5 working forms; normal revision-bound jobs cancel (JI.16, JI.28, JI.49).
assumes.if_other: Without branches use separate research sessions and make branch change unavailable; if pinned jobs are cancelled, release their references on input replacement. Exit void facts and snapshot immutability do not change.

assumes.assumed: Built-in rows keep DT-J1 and the interim chapter 07 boundary. Under flow labels observations retain state dependencies; capability separation hides them from previewing solving programs (JI.48).
assumes.if_other: The joint setting may change policy-table tiers or sinks; adjust those grants without changing exact payload semantics or inferring permissions from provenance. Neither flow form is selected here.

assumes.assumed: The research operation is a conformance input, not approval to ship research-tier selection (JI.16, JI.48).
assumes.if_other: A separate research language or omitted research tier relocates/removes that product consumer; the recorded source meanings and oracle obligations stay.

assumes.assumed: Named exact operations are portable contracts without an implementation language, ABI, placement or tariff selection (JI.14, JI.50).
assumes.if_other: The selected route supplies transfer and release operations, principle/decomposition coverage, deterministic tariffs and cancellation boundaries in the second-wave annex. No zero-copy assumption survives without evidence.

assumes.assumed: The renderer-independent publication boundary carries JI.41 producer payloads and explicit source roles; no renderer is selected (JI.43).
assumes.if_other: Different feature or presentation ownership changes the adapters/support matrix; identity pins, exact producers, full-state adoption and typed refusals remain.

owner_items.why: The packet reserves final twist-menu sign-off for the owner; current I_a pins are consumed only.
Only the owner chooses product scramble depth and the retained/jumble mix.
Q7(a) remains pending EN2 XM1; only the owner can replace it with a kept alternative.
The owner confirms whether S4 requires a preview for live turns.
Program replacement of a presented preview remains with the owner and design line; no replacement policy is enabled here.
Entry filters, layout, look, motion and repair-list presentation await owner resumption and sign-off.
The owner selects the data-core scope; choosing EN3 flat storage is not acceptance of the format freeze.

owner_items.item: JI.48 / LQ1, LQ2, LQ16 and LQ21
owner_items.why: Product/research scope, callable tiers and flow policy belong to the owner and joint setting, not this interface draft.
Experiment branches and pinned-job policy are still owner alternatives.
Built-in implementation, engine language and route/placement are not selected by the batch signatures.
The admitted feature surface, renderer selection and presentation ownership remain their existing owner decisions.
Any proposal to admit labels-only entry or revive an exit through restore would change A5. This draft keeps both refused and requests no such change.

handoff_changes.change: This earlier refinement is now part of H11: JI.26 keeps voids across undo and branch selection; JI.25/JI.27 distinguish entry/exit, Position/Context and the common workspace/action/receipt chain.
handoff_changes.why: A5 says a break voids the record and refuses labels alone. Equal-label restoration or undo must not erase that durable break. A fresh witnessed entry/exit can establish a new binding.

handoff_changes.change: The real jumble.on/off rows have no confirm gate; H2 shows confirm only in its illustrative row.
handoff_changes.why: DT-M1 C6 explicitly settles Jumble on/off as plain commands with no confirmation key; required explicit solver action tokens still apply.

new_error_codes.meaning: Only dimension 4 is implemented in this edition; refuse another dimension before array use.
Invalid named cap/piece or empty, mixed-pose or lattice-containing unit argument.
No owner-approved product scramble policy reference; no construction or state change.
Branch navigation lacks a proved journal path; refuse without changing the current binding.
Certified exposed-face geometry or its size profile is unavailable; no fabricated render payload.
A history action would reactivate a voided exit binding; refuse that redo without reviving permission.

FR-K01.why_open: The EN3 four-layer draft and EN4 layer clauses are reconciled to H11/H15 by p7-layers. The p7-table command join, p7-data encoding, renderer reconciliation and combined-candidate review still need integration.
FR-K01.who: p7-table, p7-data, p7-render and the integrator; independent final-candidate review after integration.

jumbling-four-layers.given: A solver invokes jumble.twist.menu at on-state r=10 with cap 0, pinned item 12, matching identity, an admissible classification and no protection conflict. Command C has not run before.
jumbling-four-layers.expected: Engine computes exact moved poses; store atomically writes C, its event, receipt and state revision 11; command terminal is committed; view model adopts all three pose arrays of revision 11 together. No renderer decision changes legality.

puzzle-crossing.given: At on-state r=10, exact reachable X has N=0 and nu=0, frame agreement and the full A5 journal/certificate. The user invokes jumble.off with a valid action token.
puzzle-crossing.expected: Mode becomes off, state revision advances, a new crossing event e and exit E store exact X and its label certificate; the retained suffix is empty. A later jumble.on with no intervening move replays from X, not a lift of its labels.

jumble-live-twist.given: Jumble is off; a live menu invocation names cap 0 and I_a item 12 with the correct pins and current action token.
jumble-live-twist.expected: Refused with KN5:input.menu_word_needs_jumble_on; no journal event, state revision or pose is changed. A seat name is never substituted for the pinned item.

live-preview-alternative.given: The owner instead confirms that S4 requires a preview for every live turn; the current menu commit row has preview=none.
live-preview-alternative.expected: EN4 must set preview=required and add fresh_preview; a one-letter presented preview supplies the live menu commit. The present no-preview row is not frozen under that alternative.

word-false-step-flag.given: A complete admissible menu word preview reports step=false and lifted pieces, with no protection conflict; its H3 dependencies, literal digest and full-state hash still match the presented preview.
word-false-step-flag.expected: operation.execute may commit the engine-owned end state as one journal action; step=false alone does not refuse execution. A blocked prefix instead produces no preview.

FR-K05.why_open: The jumbling producer/payload/limits rows are specified. Adapter signatures, feature-support dispositions and resource-release acknowledgements are p6 work; exposed-face sizing remains unmeasured.
FR-K05.who: Renderer p6 and the integrator for FR-K05; EN2 and renderer line for exposed-face production and sizing.

jumbling-feature-rows.given: A proposed render bundle has pose_index from revision 8 and poses/pose_lattice from revision 9; the requested features are static geometry, state, motion, overlays and projection.
jumbling-feature-rows.expected: JI.41 assigns a producer, payload and limit/refusal to each feature. This mixed bundle is refused with EV3:input.display_bundle_mismatch; the view keeps no mixed frame and requests a validated refresh.

half-turn-without-plane.given: A certified half-turn has angle pi and a valid moving set but the engine has supplied no oriented plane_u/plane_v.
half-turn-without-plane.expected: Draw the half-turn without a swept preview; no turning direction is invented.

mesh-unavailable.given: Exposed-face rendering is requested, but neither a certified exposed-face mesh nor its measured size profile exists.
mesh-unavailable.expected: Return KN2:input.exposed_geometry_unavailable; do not claim support or fabricate geometry.

device-loss-no-state-change.given: The renderer loses its device after state revision 12 committed and the complete revision-12 bundle was adopted.
device-loss-no-state-change.expected: Release device resources and rebuild from that same bundle; head, mode, episode, exact state and committed receipt remain unchanged.

exit.given: On-state revision 10 has reachable exact X, label digest L, N=0, nu=0 and valid A5 frame/C5/certificate evidence. Exit creates event e and exit E.
exit.expected: Off-state revision 11 records e, exact exit poses X, label digest L, certificate and E atomically; active replay root is X and suffix is empty.

retained-move.given: Off-state revision 11 has active E rooted at X and empty suffix. A permitted retained menu item (0,2) commits as event m.
retained-move.expected: Revision 12 remains off; active exit is E and replay root remains X; effective suffix is [(0,2)], bound to event m and its parent e.

undo.given: After retained move m, the current ActionHint names both the current order and target m; the user submits it with a valid token. E is unvoided.
undo.expected: A new undo action targets the pre-move head, mode stays off, the state revision advances, E remains active with root X and empty suffix. The old preview is not revived.

redo.given: Following that undo, redo targets the saved retained event m with word [(0,2)], an intact parent path and no intervening action.
redo.expected: New redo action restores the effective suffix [(0,2)] in its original order; mode off, root X and exit E remain; revision advances despite a recurring label digest.

branch-change.given: E is unvoided; two recorded off-state forks share E: branch A has retained word [(0,2)] and branch B has [(0,5)]. Navigation proves undo(A) then redo(B).
branch-change.expected: Branch B becomes active with replay root X from E and suffix [(0,5)], keeping current preferences and protection under JI.27; no label-digest lookup selects a root. Missing navigation evidence instead returns KN4:input.branch_path_unproved with no change.

restore.given: Off-state has active E. A checkpoint with exactly the same labels and a saved reference to E is restored; no retained word from solved accompanies it.
restore.expected: Restore writes a new state event and void_exit(E) atomically. Active exit is absent, even though the labels match. The next jumble.on returns KN5:input.jumble_on_labels_only.

import.given: A valid import replaces off-state labels with the same labels, carries an old exit ID E, and contains a complete retained word v from solved.
import.expected: The import voids pre-break exit bindings, including E; E is not adopted. A later jumble.on uses replay(solved,v) and records that exact entrance derivation.

recovery.given: A crash interrupts an exit from X at r=10. Case A has no durable crossing transaction; case B has a complete exit e/E transaction; case C has a durable restore after E.
recovery.expected: A recovers on at the preceding committed X; B recovers off with E rooted at X; C recovers the replacement with E void. All restart in a new epoch without previews/tokens. Incomplete durability evidence enters KN5:unknown_outcome.read_only_recovery.

equal-label-different-lineage.given: Two reachable stored exits E1/X and E2/Y have equal label digest L and different exact pose digests. The verified target path ends at E2 and then retained word w.
equal-label-different-lineage.expected: The only exit-root replay is replay(Y,w). E1 is not selected by L. After a checkpoint assignment of those labels with no retained witness, E2 is void and jumble.on returns KN5:input.jumble_on_labels_only.

undo-redo-exit.given: Off-state immediately follows exit e/E from reachable exact X. Undo targets e, then redo targets that same crossing; E has no void fact.
undo-redo-exit.expected: Undo atomically restores mode on, original episode and X, with E inactive. Redo atomically restores off with the same E/root X and empty suffix. Each action advances the revision.

void-survives-undo.given: Restore has durably voided E. The user then undoes the restore and returns to the exact old label digest; the session still holds void_exit(E).
void-survives-undo.expected: E remains void. No equal-label head, undo or branch navigation erases the void fact; entry requires a retained word from solved or another valid newly established lineage.

nu-zero-without-reachability.given: An imported raw lattice pose table has nu=0, but no journal from solved or a reachable exit that reaches its exact poses. The caller asks to exit Jumble using it.
nu-zero-without-reachability.expected: Refuse with KN5:input.jumble_off_not_shown_reachable; no label checkpoint or exit record is created.

redo-void-exit.given: A saved redo targets exit crossing E, but a committed restore has already written void_exit(E). The old exact pose bytes and matching labels still exist.
redo-void-exit.expected: Refuse with KN5:input.exit_record_voided. E stays void and the state does not change. Exact content remaining in storage does not revive the session binding.

FR-B03.why_open: The jumbling observation operations/results and one research walk are specified. This packet does not supply the selected-route ABI, transfer/release acknowledgements, deterministic tariffs or retained-workflow walk.
FR-B03.who: Second wave: integrator, EN3 and EN4 after LQ8/LQ9, as HANDOFF H1/H13 assign the language-kernel annex.

jumbling-research-operation.given: A read-only research check opens solved jumbling snapshot r and supplies [(0,12),(0,45)] in the pinned I_a menu; chunk size 1, sufficient declared budgets, all prefix fields and references requested.
jumbling-research-operation.expected: seam_facts(all) at start/end returns total_N=0; units at solved is empty; replay returns two admissible rows with F=0,D=0,delta_phi=0 each, peak left height 2, excursion 0, tame=true and final pose digest solved. The first-prefix all-off pieces form one exact-pose unit; checking item45 lands it with step=true. Releasing buffers/derived refs and closing the snapshot leaves authoritative revision r unchanged.

off-grip-total.given: A supplied complete seam table has three unique mismatched (domain,cut-cell) entries: one on a grip hyperplane and two off-grip.
off-grip-total.expected: SeamTotals is total_N=3, on_grip_mismatches=1, off_grip_mismatches=2. A named-cap-only read cannot present its count 1 as total_N.

cancelled-prefix.given: The JI.16 two-letter check is cancelled after its first chunk, with one applied letter and no final chunk.
cancelled-prefix.expected: Coverage is [0,1); terminal cancellation supplies no second row or final solved claim. Job-owned buffers/handles are released, and the authoritative state is unchanged.

FR-C02.why_open: PS1.20 is resolved for EN3 as flat ia16 with optional verified annotations. p3 still owns the global canonical envelope, compression, framing and shared resource profiles, and LQ10 remains open.
FR-C02.who: EN4 format p3 and the integrator for FR-C02; owner for LQ10; EN2 for the measured X3 admission bound.

word-carrier.given: In the pinned I_a menu, ordered annotations A/B/C span [0,1)/[1,2)/[2,3). A is [(0,12)]; B same_as and C inverse_of both use relation.word={local:A}. Store flat letters, length 3, and read as chunks of 1+2 or 3 letters.
word-carrier.expected: Both streams are [(0,12),(0,12),(0,45)], hex 0c000c002d00, SHA-256 c2ae6cf7df4e002e34b55017aa22a79d7b385830a0cf513f170586410380d309, expanded length 3. Chunking and annotation names do not change literal identity; menu/order pins remain required.

missing-part.given: A named inverse_of annotation refers to a digest-pinned part definition that is absent from the supplied stored-word closure.
missing-part.expected: Refuse word/annotation admission with PS1:input.persistence_format before publishing a stored word or opening replay; do not fetch the part or trust an unverified expansion.

length-before-expansion.given: A stored language word declares exact expanded length 100000000000000000000, and the granted replay bound is the illustrative value 100; storage limits are separately sufficient.
length-before-expansion.expected: Report expanded length 100000000000000000000 and return PS1:resource_limit.word_expansion before expansion, or KN2:resource_limit.word_length_bound at replay admission. Do not truncate or split the operation. The illustrative bound 100 is not an X3 measurement or a mathematical limit.
